title: The gold / platinum and gold / palladium ratios as a signal for spot gold

rule.z: ln(gold / metal) against the 250 joint days before; |z| >= 2 -> gold traded for the ratio to revert
rule.momentum: last joint day of a month: gold's 21-day return vs platinum's
rule.entry: gold's next folded UTC daily open
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade ($0.3 spread + $0.15 slippage on each of two market orders) + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: gold / platinum ratio |z| >= 2, gold traded for the ratio to revert (primary)
gold / palladium ratio |z| >= 2, gold traded for the ratio to revert
monthly relative momentum: gold beat platinum over 21 days -> long gold a month, else short
